basics.description: Deploy Goblin infrastructure in your Azure account. Choose a dedicated resource group; rg-goblin-prod is the suggested default. Save the access-key file when Azure prompts you during creation.

basics.name: companyName
basics.label: Company or software name
basics.toolTip: Keep Goblin or replace it with your company or software name. Use 2–24 letters, numbers, spaces or hyphens, starting with a letter.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

basics.name: goblinPassword
basics.toolTip: Choose a password for opening Goblin before connecting your ChatGPT account. There is no minimum length or character-mix requirement. Save it in your password manager.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a password of up to 128 characters, including a non-space character, without tabs or line breaks.

options.text: This installs the Goblin infrastructure foundation. The Goblin application and HTTPS onboarding are not available yet. Installation failures appear in Azure's deployment page.

Choose Generate new key pair to create your VM access key here. At the final Create step, Azure asks you to download the private key file. Save it for direct VM access later; it is not needed for everyday Goblin use. If you already have a key pair, you can use its public key instead.

basics.name: adminUsername
basics.label: VM administrator username
basics.toolTip: Use this username with your saved key if you connect directly to the VM.

toolTip.authenticationType: Use an SSH key for VM administration.
toolTip.sshPublicKey: Choose Generate new key pair to download a private key when creating the deployment, or use an existing public key. Keep the matching private key file for later VM access.

elements.name: sshSourceAddressPrefix
elements.label: Your allowed IP address or CIDR
elements.toolTip: For example, 203.0.113.10/32. Only this source can connect to port 22.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

options.text: Saving a key does not open the VM to SSH. Leave direct SSH access disabled unless you need it now. An authorized administrator can enable network access later through Azure.

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: Virtual machine size
elements.toolTip: Default: 4 vCPUs and 16 GiB RAM. Choose an x64 VM size that supports Trusted Launch and is available in your region.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: virtualNetworkAddressPrefix
elements.label: Virtual network address range
elements.toolTip: Keep separate from K3s pod range 10.42.0.0/16 and service range 10.43.0.0/16.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: subnetAddressPrefix
elements.label: VM subnet address range
elements.toolTip: Choose a subnet inside the virtual network address range.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: virtualMachineName
elements.label: Virtual machine name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: vm-goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: publicIpName
elements.label: Public IP resource name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: pip-goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: virtualNetworkName
elements.label: Virtual network name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: vnet-goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: subnetName
elements.label: Subnet name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: snet-goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: networkInterfaceName
elements.label: Network interface name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: nic-goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: networkSecurityGroupName
elements.label: Network security group name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: nsg-goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: osDiskName
elements.label: OS disk name
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: osdisk-goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.

elements.name: dnsLabel
elements.label: Public hostname prefix
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for a name based on your company and environment. Default: goblin-prod.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid value using the format described above.
